stem.text: A solid cylinder of density $\rho_\text{C}$, cross-sectional area $A$ and length $X$ is submerged in a liquid of density $\rho_\text{L}$. The upper face of the cylinder is at a depth $H$ below the surface of the liquid, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a vertical cylinder below a horizontal line labelled surface of liquid. Labels: cross-sectional area A, cylinder, H (from the surface to the top of the cylinder) and X (the length of the cylinder).

stem.text: The acceleration of free fall is $g$.
Which expression gives the magnitude of the upthrust force acting on the cylinder?
